title: ornithopus sativus nothosubsp. macrorrhynchus
intro: Ornithopus sativus nothosubsp. macrorrhynchus, commonly known as subalpine broom, is a legume plant native to Australia. It has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including its ability to support digestive health and act as a natural diuretic. The plant's therapeutic actions include its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties, which may help to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms of urinary tract infections. Bioactive constituents of Ornithopus sativus nothosubsp. macrorrhynchus include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
